content: The Publication Committee is tasked with identifying opportunities to publish work that originates from the activities of the Society. Its primary responsibility is to oversee the publication of papers presented at the biennial International Symposium on the Biosafety of Genetically Modified Organisms. Additionally, the Committee may assist in publishing the proceedings of smaller, regionally or technically focused meetings organized by the Society. The Committee periodically evaluates the desirability and feasibility of establishing a peer-reviewed journal dedicated to biosafety research. It is composed of a Chairman and other interested members, with the possibility of co-opting additional members to manage publications in their specific areas of expertise. The Chairman of the Publication Committee has several key responsibilities. These include informing the ISBR Board about opportunities to publish the Society’s work, acting as the editor-in-chief for publications arising from the Society’s activities, and co-opting members to serve as editors for specific publications when necessary. The Chairman is also responsible for ensuring that publications are cost-effective and for collaborating with the Communication and Outreach Committee to ensure that the publications align with and advance the goals of the Society.
